  cardMarketContent = '## Age of Ultron: New Heroes, New Cards

Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015) introduced several characters who would become central to the MCU''s future — Scarlet Witch, Vision, and Quicksilver. For card collectors, this film''s sets represent the debut of characters whose values have only grown over time.

### Key Sets

The **2015 Upper Deck Avengers: Age of Ultron** set features the full ensemble cast with autographs from newcomers Elizabeth Olsen, Aaron Taylor-Johnson, and James Spader.

### Market Trends

Elizabeth Olsen (Scarlet Witch) autograph cards from this set have skyrocketed in value following WandaVision and Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness. James Spader Ultron autographs are undervalued given his iconic voice performance.',
  keyCards = '- **Elizabeth Olsen as Scarlet Witch First Auto** — Her MCU debut card, now extremely valuable ($3,000+)

- **2015 Upper Deck Age of Ultron Sketch Cards** — Original 1/1 team artwork',
  content = '## The Avengers Expand

Avengers: Age of Ultron was the most ambitious MCU film to date when it released — a $365 million production that juggled the original six Avengers while introducing Scarlet Witch, Quicksilver, Vision, and the titular villain Ultron. While it didn''t quite match the original''s cultural impact, it grossed $1.4 billion and set up the MCU''s future in crucial ways.

## The Legacy

- **Introduced Scarlet Witch** — Elizabeth Olsen''s Wanda Maximoff became one of the MCU''s most powerful and complex characters
- **Created Vision** — Paul Bettany''s android hero became central to WandaVision
- **Set Up Civil War** — The Sokovia Accords and Tony/Steve tension directly led to the next Captain America film
- **The Hulkbuster Fight** — Iron Man vs. Hulk remains one of the MCU''s most spectacular action sequences
- **Quicksilver''s Sacrifice** — Aaron Taylor-Johnson''s only MCU appearance made it memorable

## Fun Facts

- James Spader performed all of Ultron''s scenes on set in a motion capture suit
- The Hulkbuster sequence took over a year to complete in post-production
- The party scene where everyone tries to lift Thor''s hammer was largely improvised
- Elizabeth Olsen and Aaron Taylor-Johnson developed their own twin language

## Viewing Context

Avengers: Age of Ultron is the **eleventh MCU film** and the fifth entry in Phase 2. The post-credits scene shows Thanos putting on the Infinity Gauntlet, directly setting up the Infinity War storyline.',
